## Series Overview

Every week I pick a handful of the most relevant papers from arXiv and the HF Daily Papers list — filtered against my own work (semiconductor X-ray/casting defect detection, VLM fine-tuning, auto-label verification) — and write each one up twice: once so a 5-year-old could follow it, once with the full methodology, a code sketch, and an honest note on whether it's actually useful for what I'm building.

**Papers covered so far:** 32

**By topic:** Vision-Language Models (7), Segmentation (6), Anomaly Detection (4), Reasoning & Agents (4), Benchmarks & Evaluation (3), Multimodal Learning (2), Diffusion Models (1), Generative Retrieval (1), Medical Imaging (1), Model Efficiency (1), Reinforcement Learning (1)

## Posts in this Series

Most recent first.

- **2026-09-04** — [5 Papers Worth Reading — Week of September 4, 2026](2026-09-04.qmd) (5 papers)
- **2026-09-04** — [Reimplementing NC-TFAD — Fixed Prototypes vs. a Naive Baseline, Streamed Honestly](2026-09-04-nctfad-continual.qmd) — real fixed simplex-ETF prototypes vs. a naive drifting-mean baseline for task-free continual anomaly detection, streamed through all 15 real MVTec-AD categories with no announced task boundaries. Honest finding: the naive baseline actually ends up ahead (0.713 vs. 0.671 final mean AUROC), with a real streaming video replaying the measured forgetting curve category-by-category.
- **2026-09-04** — [Reimplementing PL-SCEA — When a Clever Idea Makes Real Numbers Worse](2026-09-04-plscea-anomaly-detection.qmd) — real token self-correlation reconfiguration applied to frozen DINOv2 features, tested honestly on all 15 real MVTec-AD categories. A real negative result: mean AUROC dropped from 0.831 (raw) to 0.739 (PL-SCEA), hurting 12 of 15 categories, with a real per-patch error-map video and interactive slider showing the damage is a quiet ranking-metric effect rather than an obvious visual artifact.
- **2026-09-04** — [Reimplementing ENEAS — Catching a Tracker Before It Grabs the Wrong Fish, With Real Code](2026-09-04-eneas-tracking.qmd) — real SAM2 point-prompted tracking-by-detection plus a real two-stage semantic verification layer (DINOv2 embedding match, falling back to real Qwen2-VL when ambiguous), tested on a real DAVIS-2017 sequence with 6 look-alike goldfish. Real result: mean IoU 0.828 (naive) vs. 0.847 (verified), with the naive tracker catastrophically losing the target mid-clip while the verified tracker holds on -- includes a real tracking-progress video and an interactive before/after slider on the exact drift frame.
- **2026-09-03** — [Reimplementing Point-Supervised Change Detection With Real SAM2, With Real Code](2026-09-03-sam2-point-change-detection.qmd) — real SAM2 point-prompted pseudo-labels on real LEVIR-CD data (0.324 honest IoU on genuine-change examples, zero training), a refinement CNN that needed a class-imbalance fix after collapsing to predicting "no change" everywhere, and a teacher-student self-training stage that made things measurably worse -- a real, useful negative result about self-training's instability on small data.
- **2026-09-03** — [Reimplementing DPA — Zero-Shot Anomaly Generation by Transfer, With Real Code](2026-09-03-dpa-anomaly-transfer.qmd) — a real SD1.5-inpainting LoRA fine-tune on real MVTec-AD data, with three (defect type, product) combinations held out entirely from training and generated zero-shot at inference, checked against the real (never-trained-on) photo. Includes a real failure and fix (the model initially ignored the mask outside a tiny defect region; RePaint-style latent blending fixed it) and a mixed, honestly-reported result: one genuine zero-shot success, two partial ones.
- **2026-09-03** — [Reimplementing Lightweight VLM Adaptation for Multispectral + SAR, With Real Code](2026-09-03-vlm-multispectral-sar.qmd) — a real Qwen2-VL-2B LoRA-tuned via its own multi-image interface, trained on real So2Sat Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 data to classify 17 local climate zones. Real 28.6% held-out accuracy (5x chance) with an honest confusion-matrix finding: natural land-cover classes learned well, urban building-density subclasses collapse into one bucket.
- **2026-09-03** — [3 Papers Worth Reading — Week of September 3, 2026](2026-09-03.qmd) (3 papers) — lightweight VLM adaptation for multispectral/SAR imagery, zero-shot anomaly generation via transferring real defects across products, and SAM2-primed point-supervised change detection.
- **2026-09-03** — [Reimplementing InstEditSeg — Segmentation as Instructed Image Editing, With Real Code](2026-09-03-insteditseg.qmd) — a real SD1.5 U-Net expanded for image conditioning (InstructPix2Pix-style), a zero-init DINO Feature Guidance Block, LoRA fine-tuned on real Kvasir-SEG polyp images to render a color-overlay edit instead of a binary mask. ELI5, data-scientist breakdown, jargon glossary, a real training-progress video, and an interactive before/after slider.

ELI5 section, data-scientist breakdown, jargon glossary, and a real training-progress GIF.
